earnings.title: Shareholder Letter
highlights: We believe the most valuable investments we can make are in sustaining long-term gross profit growth, which is where we are focused in 2027 as we drive toward 30% Adjusted Operating Income growth.
Adjusted Operating Income grew 92% year over year to $923 million, with an all time high margin of 29%, and Adjusted Diluted EPS grew 109% year over year to a record $1.13.
Operating income was $428 million, up 5% year over year, while Adjusted Operating Income grew 92% year over year to $923 million.
Net income attributable to common stockholders was $566 million and Adjusted EBITDA reached $1.2 billion.
GAAP diluted EPS was $0.92, and Adjusted Diluted EPS grew 109% year over year to $1.13.
outlook: We exceeded our guidance with 22% gross profit growth, 92% Adjusted Operating Income growth, and 109% Adjusted Diluted EPS growth, and we raised our guidance across each of these metrics for the year.
We expect Adjusted Operating Income to grow 30% year over year to $4.575 billion as we expand margins while still investing meaningfully to sustain long-term growth.
We've delivered over 20% constant currency GPV growth in each quarter for the past six years, and we expect to sustain that strength in 2027.

items.heading: Our growth rate has slowed at times and may slow or decline in the future, and our growth rates in each of our reporting segments may vary. Future revenue and gross profit growth depends on our ability to retain existing sellers and customers, attract new sellers and customers, and increase sales to both new and existing sellers and customers.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Our Industry

items.heading: We have generated significant net losses in the past, and we intend to continue to invest in our business. Thus, our profitability may decline.

items.heading: Our recently announced workforce reduction and related reorganization, including the potential for increased reliance on proactive intelligence and artificial intelligence tools, may not achieve their intended benefits and could adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.
